title: Cocktail-party audio as a reverse Turing test: humans beat speech models, but not by enough [P]
summary: Hello - I wanted to share a small project I worked on test whether picking one voice out of background chatter could separate humans from machines, in the spirit of an audio CAPTCHA. Setup 40 synthetic clips: one target sentence read by a synthetic voice, mixed over multiple back
